sentences.text: Sandeep Kumar Bhateja vs . State Of H.P. on 3 March, 2026

Author: Ajay Mohan Goel
Bench: Ajay Mohan Goel
Sandeep Kumar Bhateja Vs. State of H.P. Cr.MP(M) No.1160 of 2022 .
Present: M/s Y.P. Sood and Praveen Chauhan, Advocates, for the petitioner.
Mr. Rajat Chauhan, Assistant Advocate General, for the respondent-State.
Mr. Kartik Kumar, Advocate, for the of complainant.
Cr.MP No.409 of 2026 rt
By way of this application, a prayer has been made by the
applicant
/ petitioner
for grant of permission to travel abroad w.e.f. 19.03.2026 to 04.04.2026.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner intends to visit Japan in connection with his business engagement w.e.f. 19.03.2026 to 04.04.2026 and he has also got his tickets etc. booked.
Learned Counsel submitted that Travel Itinerary of the petitioner is appended with the petition as Annexure A-2.

Learned Counsel Further submitted that in the FIR, the police has filed a cancellation report, which is pending consideration before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Shimla, H.P., but on account of non-appearance of the complainant, the case has now been listed in the month of June, 2026.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Shimla, H.P.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned Counsel in these circumstances submitted that as the petitioner has otherwise abided by the conditions of grant of bail and not jumped the bail, the application be allowed by permitting him to travel to Japan.

Learned Counsel for the non-applicant/ complainant submitted that in light of the prayer made in the application and in light of the fact that the petitioner intends to visit Japan only in between 19.03.2026 to .
04.04.2026, appropriate orders be passed in the application.

Having heard learned Counsel for the parties, the application is disposed of with the direction that the applicant is permitted to visit Japan for the period of mentioned in the application on account of his business purpose, subject to the condition that he shall furnish the address(es) and also contact numbers, with the learned Trial rt Court, within a period of one week from today.

After making his submissions for some time in the application, learned Counsel for the applicant/petitioner submits that in case this Court allows the petitioner to move an application before the learned Court below for preponement of the case and learned Counsel appearing for the respondent/complainant gives an undertaking to appear before the learned Trial Court in the matter, the application shall not be pressed at this stage.

Learned Counsel appearing for the Sandeep Kumar Bhateja vs . State Of H.P. on 3 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191187266/
1 non-applicant/complainant submits that the complainant shall put in appearance through Counsel before the learned Trial Court.

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar Bhateja vs . State Of H.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In light of respective contentions of the parties, this Court directs that let the matter in FIR No.36 of 2022, dated 10.05.2022, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code be taken up by the Court on 12.03.2026, on which date the complainant shall appear before the Court through Counsel and thereafter, the Court will proceed in the matter in accordance with law.
The application, therefore, stands disposed of as not pressed.

Learned Counsel for the .
petitioner shall be at liberty to move an appropriate application before the learned Court below for listing of the case on the said date on the strength of the order passed by the Court today.
of This application is disposed of with the direction that let the applicant shall file translated copy of Annexure rt A-3 within a period of one week from today.

Ajay Mohan Goel) Judge March 03, 2026 (Rishi)
